definition: The next bar's volatility forecast from a GARCH(p, q) model fitted to the log returns of the last window prices: today's variance from a constant, the last squared returns and the last variances.
boundaries: Not computed in QML yet: it is fitted to history by numerical optimisation, which belongs in the Lab's training placement; it runs in shadow in the MIS until his yes, behind the same reading shape, so no unit changes when it goes live.
recognition: Volatility clusters: a calm stretch forecasts calm, a burst forecasts more.

class_meanings.index_cfd: A return across a session close, a weekend or a contract roll is a gap, not a bar's move; bind the statistic to bars inside one session or a back-adjusted series, or it reads the gap.
